_about: SERIES SHELF of one-off translators: Routledge's Broadway Translations and Broadway Medieval Library (1920s). Lunacharsky's Three Plays (Magnus and Walter, 1923), Lucy Allen Paton's Sir Lancelot of the Lake (1929), Mabbe's Celestina (1631, reprinted 1923) and the English Faust Book (1592, modernized by William Rose, 1925). The series' classical volumes (Petronius, Alciphron, Lucretius) are left for Lane B. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 57); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
